scope: Independent dependency and licence review; narrow security documentation edits in the unreleased candidate only

rights.conditions: Retain upstream copyright, licence conditions and disclaimer. Do not imply author endorsement. System Lab and other third-party rights remain unchanged.

historical_boundary: Frozen 0.3.1 requirements actually pin 6.21.3; old artifacts and audit dates remain unchanged. Existing installations are not patched by new documentation. The product root environment remains 6.21.3 while the candidate environment is 6.21.4. Generate release metadata using the candidate environment.

mobile_review.visual_review: Actual capture independently viewed. No email, private account header, customer activity or operational data visible. The regulatory role, permission guidance and empty operational counts are visible.

verification_limit: Root is rerunning corrected gates; this review does not claim a final passing audit, installation, release or operational acceptance.

reference_boundary: Parent researched official advisories and release. This independent review used the preserved actual audit, locked official PyPI artifacts and installed primary licence metadata. No new remote request.
follow_up: Complete corrected candidate gates and regenerate audited SBOM and notices before release.
